prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production game asset: one truly transparent RGBA sprite sheet of exactly TWELVE COMPLETE Fabius figures, two rows of six, no text. Input 1 is authoritative approved Fabius identity/costume in Normal; input 2 is approved frontal walking identity/scale; input 3 gives the NORMAL neutral katana equipment; input 4 is eye shape/color only, do NOT adopt its red transformed hair. New artwork must preserve the approved dark brown untransformed hair, dark red eyes, clean warm skin, young face/proportions, black long coat with restrained burgundy lining, small red physical seam/stud accents, black gloves and black boots, metal belts. No new armor spikes, no red aura, no red blade, no glowing crystals or transformed hair. Neutral silver curved katana with black/gunmetal hilt held in the anatomical RIGHT hand. Keep head, body, both hands, boots and ENTIRE blade together, never composite anatomical pieces.
Row 1: six successive WALK SOUTHWEST poses, heading down-left at 45 degrees: head, shoulders, chest, hips, legs and blade all project coherently down-left. Row 2: six successive WALK WEST poses, true left-facing profile: nose and boots point left. Draw those directions genuinely; do not mirror a frontal figure or swap the weapon hand. Match the approved slightly elevated 2D RPG camera.
For EACH row, show a continuous distinct six-phase gait: phase0 LEFT heel forward contact, right rear toe-off; phase1 left support while RIGHT knee flexes behind; phase2 right leg passes under hips; phase3 RIGHT heel forward contact, left rear toe-off; phase4 right support while LEFT knee flexes; phase5 left leg passes under hips into phase0. Alternating legs must be unmistakable. Naturally opposed shoulders/hips, controlled lowered katana, small cloth movement, stable skull/body size. No skating, identical leading leg or repeated poses. Maintain same character identity and body scale across all twelve.
Make crisp intentional pixel clusters like references, no blur, no painterly lighting. Generous transparent spacing around every complete character AND blade. Large landscape canvas with twelve readable complete figures. No cropping of tips, no overlaps, no cast shadows, floor, checkerboard pattern, borders, labels or background gradients. Actual transparent background. This is ONLY Normal Requiem, do not mix in any transformation.

Targeted correction of the entire twelve-figure sprite sheet (input1). Keep the approved Fabius identity/costume from input2 and original approved frontal walk input3. Preserve complete characters and every blade. Redraw the poses, not filters or anatomical pieces. The current input1 fails two specific requirements: its first row still looks FRONT-facing and nearly every pose has the same visible leading boot; its second row is three-quarter instead of PROFILE. Correct those failures visibly.
Make EXACTLY twelve figures with generous transparent separation, two rows of six. TOP ROW must be SOUTHWEST, with nose, sternum, hips and toe direction pointing DIAGONALLY DOWN-LEFT, a clear 45-degree body turn from frontal. BOTTOM ROW must be true WEST PROFILE: nose points directly LEFT, one visible eye only, one shoulder hides the other, chest points LEFT, boots point directly LEFT. All figures remain complete, entirely inside canvas.
For BOTH rows enforce six really different gait phases in order left-to-right: 0 anatomical LEFT leg LONG FORWARD, right leg LONG BACK; 1 right knee bent and swinging forward, left support; 2 RIGHT boot passes left boot beneath hips; 3 anatomical RIGHT leg LONG FORWARD, left leg LONG BACK; 4 left knee bent and swinging forward, right support; 5 LEFT boot passes right beneath hips. Poses0 and3 MUST have opposite anatomical legs extended. Show obvious stride inversion, no duplicate lead leg, no repeated near-identical pose. Keep coat tails apart enough to read the knee and foot exchange. Arms oppose the stride; silver katana stays in anatomical RIGHT hand and fully visible. Continuous 400ms walk loop, no jumping, skating or running.
Fabius Normal Requiem: young warm clean skin, brown untransformed hair, dark RED eyes, black long coat, restrained burgundy lining, small red physical studs/seams only, black gloves/boots. Match input2 exactly for identity and normal costume. Silver neutral katana, graphite/black hilt. No magical aura, red blade, crystals, giant gauntlets, transformed hair or tinted face. Crisp pixel-cluster raster matching approved art, stable proportions. Actually transparent RGBA background; no gradient, shadows, floor, checkerboard, text, frame or labels. No smoothing, anatomical assembly, mirroring, flat rotations or image warping.

Create a GAME WALK-CYCLE spritesheet. TWELVE distinct FULL-BODY game sprites of the SAME Fabius from reference 1. Reference 2 shows approved normal walking costume/identity only. Draw new poses from scratch, not edits or duplicate silhouettes. Arrange THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS on a square transparent canvas, with very generous clear space between all complete blades and boots. First SIX figures (rows1-2) are SOUTHWEST diagonal walking, chest and nose point down-left, showing left-facing three-quarter body. Last SIX (rows3-4) are WEST walking in strict LEFT PROFILE, nose directly left and only ONE visible eye. Slightly elevated RPG camera. Keep BOTH directions clearly distinct.
Each set of SIX must depict an honest six-frame in-place walking cycle. The near leg AND far leg exchange roles. Frame1 near leg extended forward, far leg stretched back; frame2 near leg supports and far knee swings forward; frame3 feet pass underneath hips; frame4 FAR LEG EXTENDED FORWARD and NEAR LEG STRETCHED BACK, the reversed stride from frame1; frame5 far leg supports and near knee swings forward; frame6 feet pass with near leg advancing into frame1. NO repeating the same boot forward. Show full visible stride reversal and both knees clearly. Restrained walking, not running or lunging. Keep head and torso scale steady, feet on same virtual ground line, cloth trails opposite walking, silver katana lowered in anatomical right hand throughout.
Identity absolutely matches approved reference: dark brown layered hair, clean peach skin, dark red eyes, young stern face, black long coat with modest burgundy interior, black gloves/pants/boots and silver belt. Normal form without transformation: NO glowing hair, red blade, giant spikes, crystals, auras, energy or tinted skin. Full silver steel curved katana, black neutral hilt. Do not include transformed equipment from any image.
Every sprite must include entire hair, head, hands, coat, feet, hilt and blade tip with ample margin; never overlap. Match crisp intentional pixel-cluster raster art of reference. Truly transparent background, not black or gradient or checkerboard. No ground, shadow, captions, grid, text, smoothing, anatomical pieces, mirrors, rotations or deformation. Each full sprite is independently drawn.
